engagement.client: Solstice Financial Services (SYNTHETIC - fictitious entity created for AssureAI pilot testing; not a real client)

risk.risk_description: Emergency changes deployed to production without timely post-implementation review could introduce unauthorized or untested changes that go undetected.

control.control_objective: To ensure that all emergency changes require documented Change Advisory Board (CAB) post-implementation approval within 2 business days of deployment.
control.suggested_control_description: Emergency changes get CAB approval after the fact within 2 days.
control.control_frequency: Per event (triggered by an emergency change)
control.expected_evidence: CAB post-implementation approval record in the change management tool.
control.suggested_test_procedures_tod: Inspect the RACM and walkthrough documentation to confirm the control is designed to require CAB post-implementation approval of emergency changes within 2 business days of deployment.
control.suggested_test_procedures_toe: For a sample of emergency changes in the period, inspect the change ticket and CAB approval record to confirm approval was obtained and evaluate whether it was completed within the 2-business-day SLA.
